title: Alvin Kamara has ‘no beef or bad blood’ with Saints despite skipping voluntary workouts

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Alvin Kamara has ‘no beef or bad blood’ with Saints despite skipping voluntary workouts
sources.description: While Alvin Kamara hasn't been attending New Orleans' voluntary workouts this offseason, he showed up Wednesday for the team's OTA practice and meetings, with his role in 2026 uncertain.
